description: This file contains functions for importing and exporting CSV data, including functions to generate CSV content from data arrays and to import CSV data into the system with options for header processing and syntax validation.

methods.name: exportDataToCSV
methods.description: Generates CSV formatted string from data array, with optional headers and custom delimiter.

methods.name: importCSVData
methods.description: Reads CSV file, processes header if specified, validates line field count, and returns parsed data with feedback.
